project.name: Reusable ML Deployment Platform
bullets: Built a reusable platform for training and serving ML and LLM models, with Airflow pipelines feeding versioned data into MLflow-tracked experiments and containerized FastAPI services.
Tested pipelines and services through Jenkins CI/CD, deployed them to Kubernetes on Azure with Terraform, and monitored latency and model performance with Kibana dashboards.

paragraphs: I am applying to join the Engineering team at Halfspace as an AI Decision Science Consultant. Over more than eight years I have moved from data engineering into ML and AI engineering, building the pipelines and services that let models leave the notebook and do real work. That path, from raw data to running systems, is what ties my work together.

Halfspace started by predicting live football matches and now brings the same precision to business decisions, a place where engineering quality decides the outcome. That is the standard I want to work to. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Copenhagen together and settle there long term.

I would bring a builder's view of AI infrastructure. At Viavi I deployed an SLA breach prediction service with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow that reduced downtime by 67%. Earlier I wrote SQL and PySpark pipelines that cut manual healthcare reporting effort by 95%, work that taught me how much reliable data plumbing matters to every scientist downstream.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Building for teachers with very little time has made me careful about reliability and plain design. I would welcome a conversation about how I could help your team.
